scope: Standard workspace root identities, precedence and transactional folder lifecycle

materialDependencies.purpose: Previous IDE rename prefill cohort and pinned external frontend/XRT dependencies; previous tests are not counted as executions in this phase

evidenceNotes: Replace the boolean-only root heuristic with retained immutable root snapshots. A present workspaceFolders null/empty list overrides legacy fields; a present rootUri null overrides rootPath. Strict absolute file URI/UTF8/name/duplicate and64-root/2MiB known-metadata bounds. No manifest/directory reads, source scans or cwd changes. Reuse XRT values, reference counts and lexical path APIs.

Validate both folder arrays before replacing state. Apply removals then additions; reject malformed/oversized metadata atomically. Existing additions and unknown removals are idempotent, labels/escaping/case/trailing separators preserve semantic identity. Empty notifications retain the existing snapshot without decoding all old paths. Retained old roots survive new snapshots.

Real root-set changes alone increment folder revision and input generations, cancel old analysis/reference/rename/workspace-symbol work and pause stale background workspace refresh. Global queries require a new complete configuration. Removing the last root without a catalog restores independent-file standard rename; an existing catalog remains invalid until refreshed.

Existing standard rename/prepare invalidation fixtures now perform actual root additions instead of treating empty events as changes. Preserve the exact cancellation and full-configuration assertions. New28-case real-native driver covers precedence, pending cancellations, no-op pending rename, invalid event rollback, capacity, initialization retry and lease notification replay. All237 protocol cases pass.

Fresh119-unit native and139-unit GUI builds,661 root metadata checks,55 GUI suites,47 actual IDE modes and24-frame C/xlang application renders pass. Check C/xlang typing/deletion/undo/Unicode/IME/click focus and existing asynchronous full rename/consent/transaction/recovery. No previous native-specific fixtures or legacy-peer cases are counted as fresh runs.

Five unit and three server actually compiled bad implementations are rejected: null-root fallback, duplicate paths, skipped metadata capacity, label-only invalidation, ignored removal, empty-event invalidation and stale reference/symbol results. Retain the prototype warning failure, first-driver expected-stderr/cleanup failure and countermodel include-path failure; only final successful executions qualify.

Bind actual source/header/SDK and link inputs,119 native and139 GUI objects,72 raw core archive members, private basename-only GUI adapters and local Python protocol imports. Default runtime, selected SDK, active delivery and online channel remain unchanged; preserve unrelated staging/worktree and original user temporary directories. Test aliases are hash-checked and removed from root release/win_x64; compiler temporary paths stay scoped to F.
limits: This is a prerequisite for asynchronous manifest/member discovery, not automatic workspace loading. No directory membership/source freshness proof or capability declaration for a completed automatic folder service. Full project discovery and validation across closed-file membership changes remain required.

No whole-goal latency/RSS/endurance/Linux/sanitizer qualification. Root metadata is bounded but temporary snapshots/DOMs/allocator overhead are additional. Shared changed-body capture, owner transport waits, client-stop waits, native/engine asset alignment, generic applyEdit and remaining LSP/static/completion capabilities continue.

No DAP or runtime/debug completion. The previous3 legacy dialog failures are not fixed/rerun/counted as passing. No default installation or online publishing in this phase; long-term goal stays active.
